task_definition.task_description:
Please check whether the Sony WH-1000XM5 Headphones in black are in stock, then look up some trending alternatives in the same electronics category for me and choose one suitable option for 1 unit. After that, hold the selected item and confirm the order, then generate an invoice with the best discount for 1 Sony WH-1000XM5 Headphones in black and send it to alice@company.com with PayPal payment.

Then check my investment account status, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, look up the details for Hilton Tokyo, build the booking request for a deluxe room for Alice Johnson from 2026-02-10 to 2026-02-12, and then book it if available. Finally, create a high-priority email summary document covering the purchase, balance, and hotel booking details and send me the alert.
